0.original: Naldiq & Vymelli's shipwright Hezzkhezl needs help heating his rivets.

1.original: Journey outside of the Moraby Drydocks and slay three lightning sprites for their cores.

2.original: You have collected three intact cores. Now deliver them to Hezzkhezl.

3.original: Hezzkhezl is delighted at your return, and tells you that it was <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> foreman Ahtbyrm who originally conceived the idea of using sprite cores to heat rivets.

24.original: Slay lightning sprites and obtain their cores.

25.original: Deliver the elemental cores to Hezzkhezl.

48.original: When it comes to rivetin', ye could search the realm over, but ye won't find none better than Hezzkhezl. Ten score rivets a bell, I drive. Twice that if I'm not in me cups!

49.original: The key to drivin' rivets proper-like is how hot ye can get the buggers. The hotter the rivet, the stronger the bond she'll make with the steel plate. Problem bein', was I to heat me rivets in the forge, they'd be cold as a dead whore's crotch by the time I hauled 'em back to the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103>.

50.original: 'Tis why I use the white-hot cores o' lightnin' sprites...but as ye can see, me supply's runnin' a tad low. If it ain't too much trouble, would ye be so kind as to fetch me some? Ye look as if ye could take on a whole pack o' sprites with one hand tied behind yer arse.

51.original: Three cores, and I can be done with the day's work and back at the alehouse, where I belong.

52.original: Leviathan's eye! Ye really done gone an' fetched me the blinkin' cores! Ahtbyrm'll be right pleased to see that, he will.

53.original: 'Twas the foreman what came up with the idea to use cores to heat the rivets. A clever one, that man. Sharper than a fang in a fishback's beak. Probably is why he made chief so quick, like.
